01 · Why Sunsets

THE MOMENT
THE WORLD
STOPS FOR.

Every evening, everywhere, the same thing happens. People stop. They turn toward the horizon. They take a photograph. A sunset requires no explanation. SUNSETS takes that universal ritual and turns it into a destination.

The experience begins with something people already want to do — then gives them a reason to stay.

02 · The Concept

ONE ROOM.
A WORLD OF
GOLDEN HOURS.

Private niches frame different horizons around the world. The room stays intentionally dark and quiet so the sunset remains the visual event. Architecture, light, sound, scent, cocktails and service support the scene without turning the experience into a themed restaurant.

The technology should disappear. Guests should remember the horizon, the people they were with, and how the evening felt.

03 / 06

SKY ABOVE.
SKY BELOW.

Reflective · Still · Elemental

A thin layer of water turns the landscape into a mirror. The horizon almost disappears, leaving the booth surrounded by amber light and reflection — a scene designed around stillness rather than spectacle.

Horizon 02
NEW YORK
04 / 06

THE CITY
IN GOLD.

Metropolitan · Intimate · Electric

Manhattan turns amber as evening moves across glass and stone. Dark materials, restrained city sound and warm table light create a metropolitan atmosphere without copying the city literally.

05 / 06

NO EDGE
TO THE HORIZON.

Warm · Tactile · Grounded

The plain becomes a field of copper, muted gold and violet. Linen, timber, leather, dry grass and acacia cues bring warmth into the booth while the view remains expansive and elemental.

Staggered Time Zones

A CURATED CASCADE OF GOLDEN HOURS.

The room is programmed around staggered time zones so a sunset is always in motion somewhere. The default experience remains curated for visual coherence; selected booths, private events and premium modes can introduce guest choice without turning the room into ten unrelated screens.

The SUNSETS Passport

A GLOBAL NETWORK OF GOLDEN HOURS.

Every new SUNSETS venue adds another real horizon to the system. The Passport turns repeat visits into a collection of places, moments and future locations — not a discount program, but a reason to keep exploring.

06 / 06
SUNSETS by Studio NSQ

WHERE EVERY HOUR IS GOLDEN.

A rooftop hospitality ritual designed in Dubai and built to travel. SUNSETS combines cinematic horizons, private social spaces, destination-led food and drink, and a growing global scene library into a hospitality format that can evolve from one flagship rooftop into a connected international network.

“Always sunset somewhere” — a premium rooftop experience where guests choose their skyline, not their table.
